# T-1: Add status details contract

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement the summary/default and `--details` payload split for `flow get status`, including runId parity and help text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Default active status contains current status fields and omits audit/detail fields.
- `--details` active status contains default fields plus audit/detail fields.
- Context-based and runId-based status use the same details flag contract.
- Inactive status remains `{ active: false }` with or without `--details`.
- Unknown option and unknown runId failure behavior remains non-zero.

## Implementation Notes
Update `src/flow/registry.js` to register `--details`. Update `GetStatusCommand` so default output does not attach or build audit/detail fields, especially `metricsSummary`, unless details are requested.

## Test Strategy
Use focused unit/spec-local command tests for payload keys, inactive status, runId parity, help text, and unknown option behavior.
